findings.title: Silence drawer never opens for prom-only rules in list view
findings.body: In public/app/features/alerting/unified/rule-list/components/RuleActionsButtons.V2.tsx the silence drawer is gated on `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)`. In the new list view GrafanaRuleListItem only passes `promRule`, so `rule` is undefined. Clicking Silence sets showSilenceDrawer true but the condition stays false, so SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer never renders and the action appears to do nothing.

findings.title: Pause menu item requires rulerRule so never shows in list view
findings.body: In AlertRuleMenu.tsx canPause is computed as OR of ruler and prom abilities, but rendering is gated on `canPause && rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)`. In the list view rulerRule is undefined by design, so the Pause item never renders even when the prom-based ability says pause is supported and allowed. Users lose pause/unpause from the list.

findings.title: Delete menu item requires rulerRule so never shows in list view
findings.body: In AlertRuleMenu.tsx delete is gated on `canDelete && rulerRule`. In the list view rulerRule is undefined, so Delete never appears even when grafana prom abilities allow it. The handler in RuleActionsButtons.V2 only needs identifier/groupIdentifier, so the extra rulerRule requirement unnecessarily removes delete from the list.

findings.title: Federated rule protection removed
findings.body: In useAbilities.ts useAllRulerRuleAbilities hardcodes `isFederated = false` with a TODO, replacing the previous `isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)` check. Federated Mimir groups (with source_tenants) are therefore no longer treated as immutable, so Update/Delete/Pause abilities become supported when they should be blocked, allowing edit attempts that will fail or corrupt federated groups.

findings.title: Missing React key for Grafana list items
findings.body: In FilterView.tsx the grafana branch renders `<GrafanaRuleListItem rule={rule} ... />` without `key={key}`, while the datasource and unknown branches pass `key={key}`. Without keys React cannot correctly reconcile the infinite-scroll list, causing warnings, unnecessary remounts, and potential state/menu mix-ups when pages load.

findings.title: Rule view link drops returnTo parameter
findings.body: In GrafanaRuleListItem.tsx href is built as `createRelativeUrl(`/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view`)` without returnTo, while the removed GrafanaRuleLoader used `createReturnTo()` and passed `{ returnTo }`. Navigating to View from the list no longer preserves where to return, breaking back navigation to filtered/group list context.
